What degraded

  • The record: 225 claims on hosts behind the crawl boundary or answering 403 were not cleared, and nothing was routed around.
  • The record: 119 deterministic movement lines written by reverify.py were not reworded.
  • The deck: shipped at the round cap at 7.49, 0.51 under the 8.0 rung. The art median is 7.0 against the 8.5 craft floor, which stands down at the cap.
  • The deck: frame 8's type seats were lightened at ship to clear a value cut after the round 3 panel scored it, so the score row reads STALE.
  • The deck: the judges still charge floating cubes and lumpy hands on frame 4, mannequin relatives on frame 8, a plate-like wash under frame 9's type, and type over drawer pulls on frame 2.
  • Studio clock: no record_done checkpoint was stamped, so the timing report is incomplete.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Publication assets

1. The post copy

A scan ordered for something else.

At UTMB Health an AI system reviews lung cancer screening reports and also helps identify nodules found by chance. UTMB says about two thirds of its program's nodules came from patients not having lung cancer screening.

Every flag goes to patient navigator Amanda Rodriguez. A validated risk score helps her decide which follow up comes first.

Medical director Dr. Shawn Nishi calls the AI an assistant, not a decision maker.

Dr. Nishi recalls a patient in her 20s whose scan after a car accident found a nodule. Dr. Nishi says a biopsy showed lung cancer and the patient had surgery intended to cure it. According to Dr. Nishi she had a hereditary disease, and she named seven or eight relatives diagnosed with cancer.

Where you get scanned, who reads the report past the reason it was ordered?

#UTMBHealth #LungCancerScreening #PatientNavigation

The machine changed itself

  • Machine queue: five findings queued (dossier drifts from the render, coherence hard cuts block only at ship, slide guards read the whole FIG object, art plan not renumbered on reorder, lung imaging models built in the chassis) and four repeats raised.
    Each cost this run rounds or re-renders. The weekly pass is not due (last pass November 24th, 192 items queued).
  • Instincts: two confirmed, two added at 0.50 (rewrite the dossier when the build changes, a share drawing shows every part).
    Frame 9 took five builds and frame 6's first rebuild drew the share wrong.

Every change is logged in ledger/carousel/upgrades.json.

Notes

The record. The selector named 181 items due and reverify stamped 119 checked and unchanged. Four items were brought current by hand. tx-2026-0233 now says the Briscoe County Commissioners Court approved Dorothy 3's Phase 1 Chapter 312 abatement on November 9th, per Soluna's Q3 results, which the record had missed. tx-2026-0117, 0003 and 0024 were re-quoted or extended. Seven PDF-sourced items were stamped with written notes. Admitted: tx-2026-0260 (UTMB Health's AI lung nodule flagging, Galveston), tx-2026-0261 (TSMC Arizona Corporation's JETI application J0055, Brazos), tx-2026-0262 (ERCOT market notice M-B112026-01 on releasing data center community impact answers only with developer consent). Held as leads: Tarrant County's data center abatement resolution (no county-hosted copy), Cameron County's SpaceX abatement vote (journalism only), Presidio's Mainspring (no county), the FAA SMART tool at DFW (403). The deck. Carousel no. 87, UTMB Health's lung nodule program, people tone. Panel rounds scored 7.15, 7.246 and 7.49. Round 1's hard fail was frame 7's age rule printing tick numerals no figure supports, and it now engraves only 20, 50 and 80. Round 1's integrity judge showed the caption, title, cover and record title let a reader credit the two thirds to the AI rather than to UTMB's program, and every surface was corrected. Frame 9 took five builds before the art director accepted it, mostly because its storyboard plan described a build that never existed. Frame 6 was rebuilt so every lung holds one find, one from screening and two from scans ordered for something else. At ship, shipped_check found two value cuts, stale FIG lines, spelled-out ledger counts and three diagram layouts in a row. All were fixed, which re-rendered the deck byte-identical except frame 8's type seats. Prompt audit, the reading before the merge: 2,575 tool calls measured, 76 flagged as waiting on a permission decision, the longest 36.1 seconds, almost all Agent and SendMessage calls. The no-stall hook was armed at 05:03:38 UTC, judged the session unattended at start (host CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED=0), and refused nothing. Nothing stalled the run. The waits look like the host's permission classifier rather than a person, which is an inference from their size. Social delivery follows the merge and its receipt is added to this draft as each destination resolves.

This email is a draft. Nothing was sent by email. The deck is already merged to main, so these links are live. Social publishing is handled by the automation; destination receipts report what actually published.
